purpose: One stable boot for fresh or parallel agents. Runtime compiles the smallest current work context and a cheap shared network so chats coordinate without the human relaying state, while a mandatory global constitution prevents destructive rewrites and stale concurrent writes.

page_change_loop.model: Capture -> Page Change Thread -> HACER -> Execution Packet -> disposable worker -> durable RETURN -> Page Change Feed -> unread result -> Universal Host routed preview/served page

product_state.migration_rule: Habits now migrates client-side from the frozen legacy habit-history key to append-only IndexedDB, verifies equivalence before writing the marker, hydrates from DB before rendering, and queues every later UI change through a synchronous recovery outbox before DB flush. Calendar event links live additively inside canonical calendar state with a browser-local recovery mirror. Calendar and Money still require separate full-domain migrations. Agents touching persistence must load the rollback baseline and storage contract first.

hard_commands.PROMETEO EXECUTE: Load exact Execution Packet + mandatory constitution; reincarnate/resync; claim scoped work; preserve-first; prewrite resync/CAS; execute/test/persist/RETURN/receipt/update-thread/release without requiring old chat history.
hard_commands.Prometeo: RESYNC + RECOVER + CONTINUE: load current entry/manifest + mandatory constitution, infer the unfinished intent, route to one compiled packet, reconcile only relevant new deltas and continue.
CONTINUE CURRENT FRONTIER: compare tiny EPOCH; if unchanged continue immediately, if changed reload only the active compiled Work Packet; never regenerate settled context/maps/specification.

freshness_rule: Already-bootstrapped chats read EPOCH before material work and again before important writes/promotion. Same epoch means no Network/Delta reread. New epoch means reload only the active compiled packet.

seal.human_rule: If a response that should be operating under Prometeo has no violet seal, send only `Prometeo` to force resync/recovery.

legacy_chat_rule: For an already-open chat that never learned Prometeo, send `PROMETEO → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/p.txt` once. After that, `Prometeo` alone is recovery.
fallback: If compiled runtime is unavailable, fall back to NOW/PACK/LAST_RETURN/Git delta routing. Do not ask the human to reconstruct context until durable recovery paths have failed.
truth: Entry/runtime/network coordinate agents only; none grant Current, Served, publication or Human-Acceptance authority.
